# ADR-3096: A08: Documented integrity downgrade for partner feed 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Some partners lack signing capability.

## Decision

Integrations MAY adopt a documented integrity downgrade for partner feed 12 (A08-12) when a partner cannot sign payloads.

## Consequences

Compensating network controls are is expected to.
